claim_ceiling: Repairs only Full Diagnostics report handoff by adding a real ZIP export of the existing read-only complete report. It does not change diagnostics truth, owner/helper authority, Current Map or routes, Bank, Continuous Run, storage, persisted user data, Atlas, or failure semantics. Fresh iPhone proof is required after deployment.

diagnostic_matrix_update.rationale: The live Full Diagnostics Copy action produces a complete report too large for chat, and there was no file handoff. The dedicated browser matrix requires fresh evidence generation, a persistent Safari-safe download link, a real browser download event, a valid ZIP signature, all four expected members, the complete report type, all eight governed diagnostic sections, and read-only boundaries.

observed_facts.fact: Before this repair Full Diagnostics exposed Copy Full Diagnostics Report only; the action generated the current report and sent the entire JSON to the clipboard with no file or ZIP handoff.

The already-certified Atlas iPhone handoff uses a persistent Blob-backed download link after asynchronous evidence generation so a second direct user gesture remains available when transient browser activation expires.

inferred_conclusions.conclusion: Adding a persistent direct ZIP download link after the existing produceEvidence path makes the complete report attachable without changing how diagnostic truth is produced or interpreted.
